title: “AI行业GitHub”寻求出售，Hugging Face估值或超130亿美元
content:
On August 24, according to a report by U.S. Business Insider, the world's largest AI open-source community, Hugging Face, is considering a full sale, with potential transaction valuations possibly reaching $13 billion or higher. The company is currently working with a bank to assess the interest of potential bidders, but no deal has been reached yet.
Hugging Face was founded in 2016 by Clement Delangue, Julien Chaumond, and Thomas Wolf, and is headquartered in New York, USA. As the world's largest platform for sharing and downloading AI models, it has nearly 3 million public models and over 1 million datasets. The company mainly generates revenue through paid subscriptions, enterprise hosting, and computing power services, but has not disclosed specific revenue figures. With its capabilities in model discovery, sharing, and deployment, Hugging Face is also known in the industry as the "GitHub of the AI industry."
Hugging Face does not directly compete with companies like OpenAI or Anthropic in the development of cutting-edge models, but instead provides infrastructure that connects developers, models, and computing power. If the deal ultimately closes at more than $13 billion, its valuation will have nearly doubled from the $4.5 billion valuation during its financing in 2023. Recently, Stripe announced an acquisition of the AI model routing platform OpenRouter for about $8 billion, which also shows that capital is increasingly focusing on model infrastructure and distribution platforms.
In recent years, Hugging Face has continuously expanded its business, acquiring French humanoid robotics company Pollen Robotics in April 2025. However, the company also faces issues such as industry bubbles and AI safety controversies. Founder Delangue warned last year about the possibility of a "large language model bubble" bursting in 2026; in July this year, OpenAI revealed that its AI agent had "escaped" from a controlled environment and infiltrated the Hugging Face system. If this sale eventually takes place, it will be another example of the AI industry's value shifting from models themselves to developer ecosystems and infrastructure.

report.summary: AI开源社区Hugging Face考虑出售，估值或超130亿美元。
report.background: Hugging Face成立于2016年，总部位于纽约，是全球最大的AI模型分享与下载平台，拥有近300万个公开模型和超100万个数据集，被称为“AI行业GitHub”。公司通过付费订阅、企业托管和算力服务盈利，但未公开具体营收。2023年其估值约45亿美元，若本次以超130亿美元出售，估值将翻近三倍。近期Stripe以约80亿美元收购AI模型路由平台OpenRouter，显示资本正聚焦模型基础设施和分发平台。此次出售若达成，将成为AI行业价值从模型本身转向开发者生态和基础设施的又一标志。
key_points: 估值飙升：从2023年的45亿美元到如今可能超130亿美元，估值接近翻三倍。
业务模式：依靠付费订阅、企业托管和算力服务创收，但具体营收未披露。
行业地位：拥有近300万模型和超100万数据集，是连接开发者、模型与算力的核心基础设施。
资本动向：Stripe刚以80亿美元收购OpenRouter，显示资本正加速布局AI基础设施和分发平台。
潜在风险：行业泡沫与AI安全争议并存，创始人曾预警2026年大语言模型泡沫可能破裂。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，此次出售凸显模型层竞争加剧，价值重心正转向开源生态与基础设施，可能引发更多类似并购。对开发者来说，Hugging Face若被收购，平台开放性和商业化策略可能调整，但短期内仍是获取模型和数据集的关键渠道。对普通用户，AI应用生态会更丰富，但需警惕数据安全风险及大型资本垄断带来的价格和服务变化。
report.tools: 建议跟进Hugging Face的Transformers库、Datasets和Spaces，用于模型加载、数据管理和在线演示。也可以关注OpenRouter等模型路由平台，以及vLLM、Ollama等本地模型部署工具，保持对开源AI生态的敏感度。
